categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the in vitro diagnostics (IVD) industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of diagnostic reagents and instruments. It has multiple technology platforms including immunodiagnostics (colloidal gold, fluorescence, flow cytometry), molecular diagnostics (PCR, FISH), biochemical diagnostics, and also has a third-party independent medical testing laboratory. Additionally, the company has expanded into the animal health sector, including animal vaccines and diagnostic products, forming a dual track of human medical and animal health businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include gene recombination, monoclonal and polyclonal antibody production, PCR amplification, colloidal gold and fluorescence immunoassays, flow cytometry with liquid chip technology, and biochemical diagnostic methods. The company employs advanced manufacturing processes such as automated production lines for POCT devices, cell factory production for animal vaccines, and digitalized R&D innovation centers focusing on gene sequencing and nucleic acid mass spectrometry. It also integrates AI and microfluidic technologies for rapid and precise diagnostics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad range of customers including hospitals, clinical laboratories, third-party testing institutions, retail chains, and end consumers for home testing. Its products cover infectious diseases, drug testing, tumor markers, cardiovascular markers, prenatal and genetic testing, blood glucose monitoring, autoimmune diseases, inflammation, allergies, and animal health diagnostics. Major markets include professional medical institutions and retail channels in the US, Europe, China, Southeast Asia, and emerging markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global presence with production, R&D, and sales bases in China (Anji, Hangzhou, Nanjing, Chengdu, Hainan, Shanghai), the United States (including Texas and other states), Canada, the United Kingdom, Germany, the Philippines, and Southeast Asia. It focuses on localizing production and sales in key markets such as North America, Europe, China, Australia, and Belt and Road countries to mitigate trade risks and tariffs.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IVD supply chain. It controls the full industry chain from upstream biological raw materials (antigens, antibodies, enzymes) through midstream diagnostic reagents and instruments manufacturing to downstream third-party independent testing laboratories and direct sales to end users. It also integrates animal vaccine production, expanding its supply chain coverage.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include global and localized R&D innovation, expanding POCT and molecular diagnostic platforms, and developing animal health diagnostics and vaccines. The company invests heavily in digitalized R&D centers, gene sequencing, nucleic acid mass spectrometry, and AI-assisted diagnostics. It focuses on regulatory approvals (FDA, CE, NMPA), product registration, and cost reduction through process optimization and supply chain integration. The company also emphasizes expanding domestic and international markets and mitigating tariff and litigation risks.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of diagnostic reagents, instruments, and animal vaccines. The company uses a sales model dominated by distribution with some direct sales, selling under its own brands and ODM arrangements. It also derives income from third-party testing services and has investment income from financial assets. The company does not currently rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading Chinese IVD enterprise with a comprehensive multi-technology platform and dual human medical and animal health business lines. It competes with global giants like Roche, Abbott, Danaher, and Siemens in high-end markets, while leveraging cost advantages and policy support to expand in mid-to-low-end segments and emerging markets. It is among the few Chinese firms with extensive global market coverage and local production capabilities in the US and Europe.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue of approximately RMB 828 million in 2024, with a slight increase from 2023, but experienced a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 529 million, reflecting ongoing investment in R&D, acquisitions, and capacity expansion. Total assets were about RMB 8.1 billion with a decrease from the previous year. R&D investment accounted for over 35% of revenue, indicating a strong focus on innovation. The company has a global footprint and continues to grow its production and market presence despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive full-industry chain integration, multi-technology platform capabilities, and strong R&D innovation as key differentiators. It offers a broad product portfolio covering human and animal diagnostics with advanced technologies such as flow cytometry liquid chip, molecular diagnostics, and POCT rapid testing. Its global localized production and sales network reduce trade risks and improve customer responsiveness. The company also highlights its regulatory certifications (FDA De Novo, EUA, CE, NMPA) and product quality control as competitive advantages.
